subject: Capability Fabric modular HAND and SKILL claims

claims.passCondition: Recipe, plan, compilation, package, manifest, module contract, modular contract, and receipts agree on one capability kind and rebuild byte-identically.
claims.primarySurface: Capability Fabric focused selftests and package tests
claims.counterevidence: A kind mismatch verifies or repeated compilation changes bytes.
claims.observedEvidence: All active HAND builds rebuilt deterministically, verified their modular contracts, and refused kind drift.

claims.passCondition: The inactive SKILL builder emits only SKILL.md, skill.contract.json, and skill.selftest.js; Capability Fabric accepts the exact artifact and a trusted host can run its selftest.
claims.secondarySurface: Committed packet parity and modular-capability review contract
claims.counterevidence: An undeclared file appears, the contract grants authority, the artifact is rejected, or its selftest fails.
claims.observedEvidence: The committed SKILL packet matched deterministic output, the exact artifact contract passed, and the explicit external host selftest passed.

claims.passCondition: A self-consistently rehashed packet cannot change runtime semantics, portable bindings, installation, promotion, or CANON state.
claims.counterevidence: A rehashed semantic or authority mutation verifies.
claims.observedEvidence: Rehashed SKILL runtime drift and modular authority drift were refused; all output authority fields stayed false.

claims.passCondition: A reviewed HAND builds visibly to a detached modular candidate and the portable SKILL routes visibly to an inactive eight-file packet without fresh console errors; the SKILL route fits 390 by 844 CSS pixels without horizontal overflow.
claims.primarySurface: Live in-app browser interaction and screenshots
claims.secondarySurface: DOM state and mobile geometry inspection
claims.counterevidence: Wrong kind, missing modular contract, wrong file count, horizontal page overflow, or a fresh console error.
claims.observedEvidence: The HAND displayed a 13-file candidate including modular-capability.contract.json; the SKILL displayed the expected eight files and packet digest; both consoles were clean and mobile clientWidth equalled scrollWidth at 375 pixels.
